sources.title: gigi_murin_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive English|hololive EN]]'s [[Gigi Murin]].

It consists of a [[cropped hoodie|cropped]] [[orange hoodie]] with [[puffy sleeves]] that have [[turbine]]s attached and a [[animal ear hood|cat-eared hood]] with [[hair through hood|holes for her twintails and ahoge]], worn over a [[white shirt]] (which is usually depicted in fanart as a [[white tank top]]), a pair of large [[gauntlets]], [[black shorts|black]] [[bike shorts]] with [[hip vent]]s, an [[orange belt]], a [[single thighhigh|single]] [[black thighhighs|black]] and [[orange thighhighs|orange]] [[striped thighhighs|striped thighhigh]] and [[white shoes|white]] [[paw shoes|paw-shaped]] [[sneakers]]. 

h4. Appearance
